default_additional_dependencies.description: Dependencies added to each hook’s environment when installed (e.g., ['requests', 'numpy']).

default_language_version.description: Global default version for each language (e.g., 'python: python3.10'). Overrides default system version.

fail_fast.description: If true, abort all hooks after the first failure.

minimum_pre_commit_version.description: Minimum pre-commit version required to use this config. Prevents compatibility issues.

repos.description: List of Git repositories to pull hooks from. Each repo entry can specify a `rev` (tag, branch, or commit), and `hooks` to run from that repo.

hooks.description: List of hooks to enable from this repository.

always_run.description: Run this hook even when no files match (e.g., for checks like docker-image).

args.description: Arguments passed to the hook command.

description.description: Optional human-readable description for documentation or UI.

entry.description: Command or binary invoked for this hook (optional, inferred from `id` if omitted).

exclude.description: Regex pattern to exclude files from running.

files.description: Regex pattern to match files to run on (e.g., '^src/').

id.description: Hook ID (required if no `name` or `entry` provided).

name.description: Human-readable name for the hook (optional, overrides `id`).

pass_filenames.description: Pass matched filenames as arguments to the hook command.

repo.description: Git URL or pre-defined hook repo identifier (e.g., 'https://github.com/pre-commit/pre-commit-hooks').

rev.description: Revision (tag/branch/commit) to use from the repo. If omitted, defaults to the latest commit.

show_diff_on_failure.description: Show unified diff of changes made by hooks that modify files (e.g., formatters).

skip.description: List of hook IDs to skip globally (e.g., ['flake8', 'myenv'] for interactive skips).
